$schema_note: Entity registry for the Property Financials refresh pipeline (plan T9a). One entry per P&L entity in dataset order. Adding an entity = add a row here + its rows in the CSV (no code). `kind` monthly = PM monthly exports (6 standard periods, cube, history months); annual = entity-level annual statements (FY + partial-YTD periods). `layout` names the raw statement layout the normalizer expects (AF AppFolio consolidated P&L, CF 12-month cash-flow statement, A12 12-month recap, QB QuickBooks entity statement). `sameStore` = full-history PM export in the same-store TTM/YTD views; `sameStoreFy` = also in the FY same-store view; `leaseUp` = excluded from trend views (lease-up or partial history). `canonicalId` is the warehouse property-master id (server/warehouse/property-master.ts CANON_PROPERTIES; read-only join hint, never overwrites). tests/unit/property-financials-registry.test.ts proves this file agrees with the contract constants in src/contracts/property-financials.ts.
